[[United States presidential election|Presidential elections]] were held in the [[United States]] on November 7, 2028. The [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] ticket of Jane Doe and John Roe defeated the [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] ticket of Richard Miles and Mary Major.
